correctness.rationale: The vertexwise update follows exactly from neighborhood sums S-s_v-s_partner and S-s_u. The proof treats even S=0, even |S|>=2, odd |S|=1, and odd |S|>=3 exhaustively, including ties. Its odd-periodic conditions 4a-2m+2u-r=1 and S_prime=2u-1 give all binomial cases. Complete enumeration of 961184 states over 62 graphs n<=16 confirms counts and a sharp m=5,r=3 transient of 3. Finite checks supplement, rather than replace, the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: For the natural infinite two-parameter class of cliques with a matching removed, the theorem gives complete fixed-point/two-cycle counts and a sharp bounded transient. It shows invariant periodic populations yet exponentially many new fixed points at even perfect deletion, and central-binomial oscillation creation plus a sharp mod-four extinction boundary in odd-order instances. The exact quantities are meaningful to structural robustness of majority recurrence and are not determined by a general period-two convergence theorem.
